Subject: POC trial planning & workload intake — FintechX

Hi Samantha / Mark —

Great to speak earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared alignment before kickoff: 

Summary of agreed success criteria
- Validate 95th pctl latency <= 300ms for customer-chat flows at production-like load
- Stable throughput for batch scoring workload (sustained RPS) with <5% error rate
- Cost/per-token baseline and 20% improvement opportunities identified by end of trial

Evaluation plan (proposed)
1) Intake & baseline (you provide workload profile) — we run a baseline with default batching/quantization
2) Performance tuning — enable KV prefix caching + continuous batching, tune kernels/quantization profile
3) Cost optimization pass — simulate production patterns and recommend batching/quantization settings

Timeline
- You fill and return the workload intake spreadsheet by EOD Thu Feb 11
- Kickoff workshop (30–45m) week of Feb 15 — propose Tue Feb 16 or Wed Feb 17
- Trial window: Feb 16 -> Mar 1 (2 weeks of run/testing + post-trial recap)

Ownership
- FintechX: Samantha (product) / Mark Chen (eng lead) — provide test keys, workload profile, success criteria sign-off
- Redwood: Ben Carter (sales owner), Marissa Cole (solution lead), Dylan Brooks (SRE/ops)

Workload intake items we need (short list) — please fill the attached spreadsheet (fintechx_workload_profile.xlsx):
- Target sustained RPS and peak RPS (burst pattern description)
- Avg request token length and avg response token length (and 95th pct)
- Concurrent open sessions (typical and max)
- Burst characteristics (duration, recurrence)
- Percent of requests that can use KV/prefix caching or are cold-start
- Top 10 prompt templates/categories and expected distribution

Attachments
- fintechx_workload_profile.xlsx (workload intake sheet)
- redwood_poc_runbook_v2.pdf (POC runbook & test plan)

Next steps / asks
- Samantha: fill the intake sheet and confirm preferred kickoff slot by Feb 11
- Redwood: Marissa to finalize runbook and Dylan to prepare a temporary Dedicated pool for the trial

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Ben Carter

Thanks Ben — quick answers and a few clarifications from our side. 

Prelim workload numbers (high-level):
- Typical sustained RPS: 40
- Expected peak RPS (short bursts): 120 (bursts of ~30–45s during our nightly batch window)
- Avg request tokens (user message + system): ~60 tokens
- Avg response tokens: ~140 tokens
- Concurrent open sessions: usually ~20, can spike to 60 under load
- KV / prefix caching: ~35% of requests should benefit from caching (repeated prompts)

We will fill the intake sheet and target returning it by Thu Feb 11 as requested. Two security questions up-front:
1) Do you have SOC 2 Type II and can we get the evidence package or an SOC 2 letter?
2) For the trial, can we use customer-managed keys (we may need KMS/HSM) or will Redwood provide scoped test keys?

I've attached our basic system diagram — will add more details to the intake sheet.

Samantha Lee

Thanks Samantha — this is super helpful. A few notes and confirmations: 

Capacity and approach
- 120RPS short bursts + sustained 40RPS is within a standard Dedicated trial profile. We'll run an initial baseline at your numbers then run a burst test modeled after your nightly window.
- For latency targets we’ll focus on chat flows (short prompts) for the 95th pctl.

Security answers
- SOC 2: yes — we’ll share the SOC 2 Type II letter and a short evidence package (I’ll loop in our security team once we get your ATO scope).
- KMS/HSM: for trials we generally provide scoped test keys; if you need customer-managed keys we can discuss Private deployment options — I’ll flag this for the security/solutions call.

Proposed trial phases (concrete)
- Phase A (baseline): run 24–48h baseline at sustained rates with default config
- Phase B (performance): run burst tests, enable prefix/KV cache on repeated prompts
- Phase C (optimization): apply quantization/batching tweaks and measure cost delta

Action items
- Samantha: confirm kickoff time (options: Tue Feb 16 10:00 or Wed Feb 17 14:00 PT) and send intake sheet by Thu Feb 11
- Marissa: I'll need the finalized runbook and test cases by Feb 12 so we can prep the test harness
- Dylan: can you provision a 2–GPU Dedicated pool with ability to scale to 4 GPUs during bursts, and pre-load the models with a warm KV cache?

I'll also add the HubSpot deal id to the doc: HS-983721.

Thanks — I’ll standby for the intake sheet.

Best,
Ben
